capabilities: Move and indent list items with their children, including via drag and drop
Fold and unfold selected list items
Split, merge and delete items with Enter, Backspace and Delete while re-parenting orphaned children
Renumber ordered lists while preserving their start number
Select item, subtree, parents, list or note with Mod+A
extras: No default hotkeys; users must bind commands in Settings → Hotkeys. The README warns to disable Outliner before enabling Listwise because both handle the same keys. Mobile drag and drop is unsupported and mobile has not been tested on devices.
intentEvidence: Listwise follows the behavior and conventions of Outliner by Viacheslav Slinko, which many Obsidian users already know.
motivation: The README says it is for people who "outline in Markdown lists and miss the item handling of an outliner such as Workflowy, Dynalist or Logseq".
problem: Editing nested Markdown lists item-by-item lacks the parent/child handling of dedicated outliners, so moving or indenting an item leaves its children behind.

relations.evidence: Behavior, command ids and settings follow Outliner (MIT, Viacheslav Slinko), so its users can switch without relearning.
With the Zoom plugin, an indentation line click can zoom in.

summary: Outliner-style list editor that moves, indents, folds and edits list items together with their children across selections and cursors.
